identity.headline: Building Better Workplaces Through People, Culture & Purpose
identity.shortBio: Palak Mehta is a Dubai-based People & Culture Consultant helping growing organisations create stronger teams, better employee experiences and people-focused workplace cultures.
identity.longBio: Palak Mehta bridges organizational strategy with human-centered culture design. Operating across the Middle East and South Asia, Palak works alongside founders, HR executives, and leadership teams to build resilient workplace cultures, optimize employee retention, and foster inclusive, high-performance environments.
